title: Hand-Cannon Candidate
description: Heavy Report developed into a hand-cannon candidate (mode H): stronger physical recoil, a refined muzzle flash and light, a bullet streak instead of the white tracer, a slower cadence to try, and impacts by material. The four weapon-feel treatments stay as references. One fixed target and material test pieces; no enemies. Keys 1-5 switch; C changes H's cadence. Offline: nothing of yours is saved or changed.
limitations: The hand-cannon model is a primitive placeholder; its art is Arty's.
Damage and balance are experimental: 6 a hit, the Static Pulse's, at H's slower cadence.
The Static Pulse itself is unchanged; H is a separate candidate in this range only.
